A natural aptitude for investigation, healing, and transformation. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

readerCopy.body: A meeting names who holds sign-off power and who absorbs the fallout. One disclosure, audit request, or contract review gives everyone at the table a chance to correct the power imbalance before the next decision becomes final. The Sun puts responsibility on the record, while Pluto exposes the control operating behind access, money, and private information. The sextile creates a narrow route toward accountability, but someone with standing still has to use it. The next decision carries more trust because authority is named before it is exercised again.
